text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: EVAL_GATE_TRIP for eval-gate 'signup_flow' — failing 18/25 checks (output drift + safety regressions). Paging eng-oncall and ml-eval. https://redwood-internal/eval/2840001234

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page issued -> @maya (eng-oncall). Severity: P2. Escalation: +10m to @jon if unacked.

maya: ack - I'm on it, grabbing the eval dashboard and recent deploys.

jon: I'll standby. quick ask: any immediate customer-facing impact known?

maya: early snapshot: ~12% of signup_flow completions show unexpected/irrelevant output in generated welcome copy. Overall route traffic ~3% of global calls. Top affected customers: Acme Co (~1.8% of their signups), Fitly (~1.2%), Educare (~0.9%).

ashwin: is this correlated with last night's model push? which model/version is in production for signup_flow?

maya: yes, v2.4.1 rolled 2026-03-14 23:45 UTC (canary -> gradual). Canary metrics slipped but didn't breach threshold. I'm going to pin signup_flow to v2.3.8 and roll v2.4.1 back for that route. Starting now.

maya: command I'm running:
```bash
# rollback signup_flow to v2.3.8
redwoodctl rollout set --route signup_flow --model redwood/v2.3.8 --rollback --reason "eval gate trip"
```

incident-bot: Deploy job started: rollout/rollback-2840001234 initiated by maya. Watching pods...

sam: I'll enable strict output filter + temporary stricter safety checks on signup_flow while rollback completes. Adding a webhook filter to drop any output that matches hallucination heuristics.

elena-product: tagging product/CS: marketing campaign running A/B emails right now, high-value cohorts may see this. Please prepare a note — CS might need to proactively reach out to Acme/ Fitly.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: maya. Escalation timer paused.

maya: rollback finished, traffic routed back to v2.3.8. Observability: welcome_copy anomaly rate dropped to baseline within 90s. Rolling 5m window error rate: 0.8% -> 0.12%.

jon: nice work. did we identify root cause? any clue in the v2.4.1 change set?

ashwin: preliminary: v2.4.1 included a quantization tweak + tokenizer handling change. Running targeted eval across the failing prompts now to reproduce. Putting hold on further v2.4.1 rollout until we have a repro.

sam: I'll keep the stricter safety filter in place for 24h and schedule a config to auto-remove after follow-up.

elena-product: prepping customer comms: short note + incident summary + mitigation. Will loop in CS leads for direct outreach to Acme/Fitly/Educare.

maya: incident ticket IR-2840001234 created, severity P2. Actions logged: rollback, safety-filter enable, CS notif, ML triage.

jon: follow-ups: (1) reproduce with extended eval set on v2.4.1, (2) add tighter thresholds to signup_flow eval-gate (temp), (3) postmortem timeframe. Assigning ashwin and sam to ML triage.

ashwin: accepted. kicking off a full eval-scan across 10k prompt variations; will post results to the ticket and drop a summary here. ETA initial repro: ~45m.

maya: closing the page for now since metrics are stable. If anything regresses we'll reopen. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page closed by maya. Incident state: resolved (monitoring).

jon: please remember to include the exact failing prompt subset and model diffs in the postmortem. Also consider adding a pre-rollout step to run the full signup_flow eval set during canary.

ashwin: noted. will include diffs and failing samples.

sam: I'll keep the temporary filter config in a tracking PR and invite reviewers from safety and SRE.

elena-product: CS outreach drafted and queued. I'll post the customer-safe timeline once sent.

maya: thanks all — I'll update the ticket and move to postmortem after ashwin posts repro.
